mentions.name: appgoblin
mentions.description: This project uses a man-in-the-middle (MITM) proxy setup on an Android emulator (Waydroid) to capture which third-party IPs and URLs Android apps communicate with. It includes a scraper for collecting apps (adscrawler) and publishes reporting on which apps talk to which countries and companies.
mentions.problem: Lack of visibility into which third-party IPs/URLs and companies Android apps communicate with.
